items.body:
<details open>

 hexagon: KV-head team split for multicore HMX flash attention  (#31055)

* hexagon: KV-head team split for HMX flash attention in multicore

* hexagon: merge FA_HEAD_SPLIT and FA_SPLIT into single GGML_HEXAGON_FA_SPLIT flag

0 = off (token-split only); 1 = head-split, plus team-split when
n_kv_heads < N_cores so stranded cores still participate (e.g. gemma-4
with 2 KV heads on 4 cores). Where heads divide evenly across cores,
plain head-split is used.

</details>

items.body:
<details open>

metal : remove mul_mm_id amax rescaling (#30924)

The src1 power-of-two rescale in kernel_mul_mm_id is superseded by the
per expert-token amax scaling done in the compute graph
(ref: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30861), which keeps the
MoE down-projection activations within f16 range before the op runs.

Drop the two-stage reduction kernels, their scratch buffer and the
GGML_PREC_F32 dispatch added in https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/26223,
as well as the test cases that drive MUL_MAT_ID src1 out of f16 range.

Assisted-by: pi:llama.cpp/ggml-org/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF (MacBook, M5 Max, 128GB)

</details>
